name: @forest/mcp
description: The mcp, the AI's door to Forest: reads markets, search and profiles, and relays what an AI app asks to the person's signer, after a login by the MCP specification's authorization flow; and the foundation's hosted copy (deploy/Dockerfile). It keeps nothing but live sockets. test/signer.ts is a reference signer; smoke.ts checks a copy through the MCP SDK's own client.
